props.title: Corporate Event Photos and Video in Denver | Signet Artists
props.description: A photographer and a videographer for your corporate event in Denver and across Colorado, so your company can tell the story of the event after it's over.

service.name: Event photography and video
service.serviceType: Corporate event photography and highlight video
service.description: A photographer and a videographer for corporate events and private parties in Denver and across Colorado, booked with live music on one contract.

props.title: Photos and video to tell the story of your event.
props.lede: Part of what makes a great event is being able to tell its story after it's over. We can add a photographer and a videographer to your booking, so you'll have photos and a short film of something that brought everyone together.

props.title: How companies use their event photos and video
props.lede: A highlight video helps the event live on as part of your company's history and culture.

rows.text: Candidates get a real look at your team, and at what it's like to be part of it.
A few minutes of your team celebrating together gives a client a feel for the people they'd be working with.
This year's highlight video can open next year's party, a kickoff or an awards program.
Edited photos of your guests, your speakers and the music.
A short recap of your event, plus clips sized for social media.

props.html: We can add photos and video to an office holiday party, a client dinner, a gala or fundraiser, a company retreat, an after-party or a milestone birthday.

props.title: Booking photos and video with your music

rows.text: The same person looks after your music and your photos and video.
Your photographer works from the same plan as the band, so they know where the music is set up and which moments matter most to you.
Photos and video go on the same contract as your music, so there's no second vendor to find, vet and manage.
You'll usually have your photos and video within a week of the event (depending on the project).

items.q: Can I add photos or video after I've booked the music?
items.a: Yes. Just let us know, and we'll check the date and add it to your booking.

items.q: Can you photograph or film our wedding?
items.a: For wedding-day photography or film, take a look at the photographers and videographers on our Preferred Vendor List.

props.title: Tell us about your event.
props.lede: Send us the date and the venue, and we'll get back to you about photos and video for your event.
